rules.title: How to play
rules.r1: Hold the ball and pull back: it flies opposite to your pull (pull right to aim left). The short arrow shows only the ball's first direction; where it lands is your call.
rules.r2: Pull distance sets the power, and power raises both speed and height. The green zone of the bar is the power that finds the goal from that distance; yellow falls short, red goes over. Hard shots stray more, and so does a shaky pull. Flick sideways as you release to curl the ball.
rules.r3: Each series has 5 shots; the ball position, the wall and the keeper's movement change every shot.

tip.title: How to play
tip.l1: Hold the ball and pull back: it flies opposite to your pull. The arrow shows only the first direction; the rest is your judgement.
tip.l2: Pull further for a harder, higher shot. Aim for the green zone of the bar: yellow falls short, red goes over; hard shots stray more.
tip.l3: Flick your finger sideways as you release to curl the ball that way.
